description: This header file declares functions and includes necessary for a system resource monitoring component, such as creating/destroying monitors, setting polling periods, printing info, and retrieving resource info. It also handles C/C++ compatibility with extern "C".

methods.name: createSysResourceMonitor
methods.description: Initializes or creates a system resource monitor instance.

methods.name: destroySysResourceMonitor
methods.description: Destroys or cleans up the system resource monitor instance.

methods.name: setSysResourceMonitorPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling interval in seconds for system resource monitoring.

methods.name: printSysResourceInfo
methods.description: Prints the current system resource information.

methods.name: getSysResourceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves system resource information as a string, optionally including iteration delta data.

methods.name: resetIterDelta
methods.description: Resets the delta values between monitoring iterations.
